Country	Country
State	State
Bioregion	IBRA7 region name
Dataset	Dataset (either AusPlotsForest, CSIRO, Injune or Supersite)
Site.Name	Site name
Year	Year of survey
Unit.Dimensions_m	Unit dimensions (in m)
Unit.Area_ha	Unit area (in ha)
Unit.Number	Number of units surveyed
Inventory.Area_ha	Total area surveyed during the inventory
Mean.DBH_cm	Mean diameter at breast height (in cm)
Range.DBH_cm	Range of diameter at breast height (in cm)
N.all	Total number of stems surveyed
Allometry	Allometry used to estimate aboveground biomass (either Chave2014 or Paul2016)
Mean.AGB_mg/ha	Mean estimated aboveground biomass per unit (in Mg/ha)
Range.AGB_mg/ha	Range of estimated aboveground biomass per unit (in Mg/ha)
LiDAR.Acquisition	LiDAR acquisition used to build H-AGB model
Sampled.Area_km2	Sampled area (in km2)
Time.difference_yr	Absolute time difference between inventory and LiDAR acquisition (in yr)
